newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer, except for April.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer, except for April.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer on Monday, except for the April contract, lifted by constant short-covering in an otherwise lacklustre market, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 0.9 yen firmer after drifting within narrow ranges. The most-active benchmark June was up 0.5 yen at 145.9 yen.

"Ahead of a seasonal fall in output in producing countries, local investors were wary of selling at current levels, but with buying interest thin, it's too early to say the market has begun a solid upward movement," an analyst at a commodity brokerage said.
